title: Hydroponic Capsule Stack
brief: a hydroponic capsule stack that feeds its stratum - fits in the undercroft and needs water from a riser

strata: any stratum with >= 5 levels clear under a deck
footprint.note: 5 levels = 17.5 m including the header tank, under a standard deck soffit at 20 m

requires.note: the east-face manifold must sit next to a water riser
freight access to the packing hall

placement.daylight: not needed (grow-lights); happy in the dark undercroft

capacity.note: 1 food unit = one resident's daily fresh produce; 12 grow pods x 15 m2 x 2 lit rack tiers x 1.5 (stacked trays)

air.note: ventilation and CO2 enrichment from the stratum air loop

light_air.note: sits in the undercroft, so it shades nothing; exhaust air is oxygen-rich

construction.name: base hall
construction.action: pour the plinth pad, set the packing-hall capsule, hang the sign

construction.name: core
construction.action: raise the service core four levels off the hall roof

construction.name: riser tap
construction.action: cut into the stratum riser, run the east manifold and the nutrient tank

construction.name: grow pods 1-2
construction.action: plug eight pods onto the core at levels 1-2 and couple them to the manifold

construction.name: grow pods 3-4
construction.action: plug seven pods at levels 3-4 and couple them to the manifold

construction.name: header tank
construction.action: bolt the header tank into the last level-4 slot on the core (keeps the stack under the deck soffit) and commission
